watch.en: Galderma initiated further corabotase arbitration in October; Ipsen could not predict the financial impact.
watch.zh: Galderma 于 10 月就 corabotase 发起进一步仲裁;Ipsen 无法预测其财务影响。

sources: October partnering brochure; chart labeled July 2026
gaps: Counts is null: company-wide counts by numerical phase were not verified.
IPN60340 is phase 2 according to the partnering chart; the H1 appendix calls EVICTION 3 Phase II/III and not yet recruiting. A standalone active Phase III component was not confirmed.
Potravitug is phase 2 based on the SAFE KIDNEY II chart; Q3 results call the program Phase II/III. No completed transition to the Phase III component was verified.

IPN01203 and IPN60300 phase 1 are supported by the partnering chart/H1 appendix, since phase markers in the live pipeline's text were flattened. IPN01203's trial is described as Phase I/II in the appendix.

Dysport is excluded: Q3 wording says migraine submissions are underway but does not establish a completed filing, filing jurisdiction or acceptance date. Its phase 3 migraine program remains a watchpoint rather than a registration item.

Corabotase's internal origin is supported by the Q3 description as Ipsen's proprietary recombinant neuroinhibitor; other is used for neurotoxin/protein modalities not covered by the prescribed categories.
Origins were not verified for IPN60340, IPN01203 or IPN60300. Unverified codes and dated next milestones are null.

Approved tovorafenib and elafibranor were excluded because their first-line glioma/PSC programs were not verified as filed. Iqirvo's PBC label-update filing was not established as a major new indication.

URL validation: the prescribed curl -sSIL check was attempted for every listed source URL; all returned HTTP 000 / curl error 6 (DNS resolution unavailable in the shell). These URLs were opened with the live web tool, but final HTTP HEAD status could not be independently verified.
